title.zh: 第谷的高精度行星位置观测资料

rationale.zh: 把间断天文测量推进为经校准的长期连续行星位置观测，为开普勒检验并建立行星运动定律提供关键数据基础。
rationale.en: Turned intermittent astronomy into calibrated, sustained planetary-position observations, providing the decisive data used to test and establish Kepler’s laws.

rationale.zh: 评为8级观测基础设施成果：数据精度、系统校准和轨道覆盖使既有模型可被严格检验；不以没有现代期刊论文为理由降低评分。只给这一观测数据体系一份总评分，不逐年重复给8分。
rationale.en: Rated level 8 for an observational foundation: precision, calibration and orbital coverage enabled stringent tests of planetary models. Absence of modern journal papers does not reduce the rating; the dataset receives one total budget, not eight points in every year.

dateNote.zh: 这里记录汶岛观测中心1576—1597年的重点活动期。皇家图书馆保存的全部观测日志跨1563—1601年，其中行星位置资料后来被开普勒用于轨道研究；《鲁道夫星表》则于1627年出版。
dateNote.en: This record covers the principal Hven observatory period of 1576–1597. The Royal Library’s wider observation logs span 1563–1601; planetary-position data were later used by Kepler for orbital studies, while the Rudolphine Tables appeared in 1627.

sources.title: Royal Danish Library — Tycho Brahe: Observationes planetarum, original observation manuscripts
Niels Bohr Institute, University of Copenhagen — Tycho Brahe’s Hven observations, 1576–1597
Rice University, Galileo Project — calibrated observations and Kepler’s use of the data
